title: Sales Executive
description:

title: Virtual Assistant (Spanish Speakers Required)
description:
WE’RE HIRING – VIRTUAL ASSISTANT (SPANISH SPEAKERS REQUIRED)

Cornerstone Medical Solutions is looking for Virtual Assistants who can communicate in Spanish to join our professional team in Rawalpindi. This position is ideal for candidates who have strong communication skills in Spanish and want to start or grow their career in a professional environment. Freshers as well as experienced candidates are encouraged to apply.
 
KEY REQUIREMENT
*Spanish language communication is mandatory*

RESPONSIBILITIES
1.  Communicate with clients in Spanish
2.  Provide virtual assistance and support for assigned tasks
3.  Maintain accurate records and reports
4.  Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth workflow
5.  Handle basic administrative and communication tasks
 
REQUIREMENTS
1.  Fluent Spanish communication skills
2.  Freshers and experienced candidates can apply
3.  Basic computer and MS Office knowledge
4.  Ability to work in a night shift environment
 
JOB BENEFITS
1.  EOBI & Provident Fund
2.  Health Insurance
3.  Monthly Ration Package
4.  Growth Opportunities
5.  Comfortable Work Environment
6.  Pick & Drop for Female Employees
 
Apply Now:
To apply for this program, candidates should submit their CV via email with a relevant subject line.
